gaps.lead: Despite his serious injury, he finished the marathon.
He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: 'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.

gaps.lead: The tickets cost so much that we stayed at home.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ we stayed at home.
gaps.explanation: so much (money) → such expensive tickets (no article with plurals).

gaps.lead: He had just got home when the power cut happened.
gaps.sentence: ___ home when the power cut happened.

gaps.lead: I wish I had never told her the secret.
gaps.explanation: wish + past perfect ≈ shouldn't have + participle.
